verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is an 'Ironclad AI' product page with marketing headlines ('A New Era of Contract Intelligence', 'Built on how contracts really move'). That suggests built-in AI capabilities exist, but nothing describes an assistant users can hand tasks to. The API doc on AI-driven analysis covers customers building their own external integrations, not a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: any description of an in-product assistant, what tasks can be delegated (drafting, review, redlining, workflow actions), how users interact with it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
